text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Annual death rate from all natural disasters excluding extreme
Death rates are measured as the number of deaths per 100,000 people. Disasters include events such as earthquakes,
volcanoes, droughts, wildfires, storms, and floods. Extreme temperatures are not included here because their geographical
and time coverage is poor, making consistent comparisons difficult.

tspan.tspan: EM-DAT, CRED / UCLouvain (2026); Population based on various sources (2024)
Based on recorded events; coverage is more limited before the year 2000. Longer historical trends may partly reflect reporting
